messages.subject: Note or Warning: TsparseMatrix#Matrix#missing#replValue
parts:
Hello,
I've been running code from the case studies section of the R-INLA website and I was wondering whether this warning was a problem? Specifically it is from the Cosandey-Godin et al 2014 example.

Note: method with signature ‘TsparseMatrix#Matrix#missing#replValue’ chosen for function ‘[<-’,
 target signature ‘dgTMatrix#ngCMatrix#missing#numeric’.
 "Matrix#nsparseMatrix#missing#replValue" would also be valid

Thanks

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Note or Warning: TsparseMatrix#Matrix#missing#replValue
parts:
Hi,

Technically it's a "note" and not a "warning", and are generated due to how the object oriented method selection in R works for the Matrix package, and are harmless.  They are only generated the first time a certain matrix operation is carried out in each R session.  It is possible to disable the messages, but I'd have to search for the command to do that.

Finn
